Explore Your Future at UF
You + UF = Your Future!
Your future is at the University of Florida! Start here to explore what this powerhouse of graduate education and groundbreaking research has in store for you — and how you can become a part of the Grad Gator Nation.

U.S. News & World Report 2027

With over 200 doctoral, specialist, and master’s degree programs in store — plus more than 100 graduate certificate options on hand — the University of Florida stands ready, willing, and able to help you shape your future and make your own mark on the world.
